title: Newmark Facilitates $30.9 Million Sale of Trellis West, an Advanced Manufacturing Campus in Oregon’s Silicon Forest
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $30.9 million sale of Trellis West, a 214,152-square-foot advanced manufacturing and R&D campus in Hillsboro, Oregon to buyer SKB and KCB Partners.
